# Refresh execution authority

Use the approved contract revision and the immutable policy snapshot supplied by the control plane.
Identify conflicting parent requirements, child requirements, comments, and repository guidance.
State which approved source resolves each conflict. Cite its revision and evidence path.
Ask the operator to resolve conflicts that approved authority does not settle.
Candidate edits cannot weaken the policy governing the current review.

Use a fresh handoff when authority changes. Compaction does not resolve stale authority.
Keep prior snapshots and evidence. Mark affected verification and review evidence obsolete.
Reverify and review against the new snapshot before delivery.

Historical evaluation cases include BAC-53 and BAC-54.
BAC-53 established review precedence. BAC-54 refreshed stale execution context.
BAC-49 and BAC-22 illustrate review disputes and assertion-removal escalation.
These cases are historical evidence. They authorize no ticket or live-run changes.
